about_the_game:
Ragdolls. Explosions. Soviet rocket legs.

Welcome to the most chaotic, stupid, and absolutely glorious zombie shooter you didn’t know you needed.

Ascension of the Dead isn’t your average zombie game.

This is pure undead carnage mixed with satire, explosive sandbox fun, and brutal, janky brilliance.

Ascension of the Dead is a chaotic, physics-driven zombie shooter where every fight is a spectacle of explosions, ragdoll mayhem, and pure adrenaline. Whether you're dropkicking a corpse across the room or turning crowds into flying zombies with a grenade, AOTD is designed to make every encounter feel fun, violent, and stupidly satisfying.

GAMEPLAY:

Kill zombies, Watch them fly 200 meters, Get points, Spend it on insane weapons, perks, and nonsense machines, Repeat until you’re the god of moshpit madness.

FEATURES:

Explosive Combat – Use grenades, melee kicks, and heavy weaponry to obliterate enemies with style.

Brutal Kicking System – Launch zombies across the map with physics-based knockback that never gets old.

Dynamic Ragdoll Mayhem – Watch the undead fly, flop, and splatter in glorious, unpredictable chaos.

Fun Maps – Navigate eerie, claustrophobic, open, colorful levels layered with danger and tension.

Power Fantasy – Feel unstoppable as you chain explosions and takedowns in a smooth, fast-paced loop.

This isn’t about surviving the apocalypse—it’s about dominating it.

ABSURD ZOMBIE RAGDOLLS

You shoot one and it flies like it got hit by a truck.

You kick one, it explodes.

You throw an RPG into a 30-zombie pile and watch your GPU beg for mercy.

SOVIET WASHING MACHINE

Costs 40 zombie kills.

Gives you a random weapon.

Maybe a MAC-10.

Maybe an RPG.

Maybe regret.

PERK GUMBALL MACHINE

You might get: Rocket Jump Legs, Explosive Ammo, Mega Speed, Exploding Kicks

More perks coming. More chaos guaranteed.

MAPS SO FAR:

Ascend Map – vertical chaos. Climb and kill.

Backrooms – surreal underground liminal hell.

More maps in progress, including:

Soccer Field of Death

Construction Moshpit

Zombie Playground

It’s janky. It’s busted. But it’s fun as hell.

Every weapon, mechanic, and feature has been added to make the gameplay loop feel better, faster, dumber.

THE VISION

AOTD is not a horror game. It’s not serious.

It’s a sandbox slaughter sim with polish layered under madness.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains intense violence, blood and gore, and strong language. Some scenes may be disturbing to sensitive players. There are no depictions of sexual content or abuse.
